thread:
maria: Heads-up — since the keystore proxy rate-limit rollout (~10:02 UTC) we're seeing a big spike in GPU warmup failures in us-west-2. Pods keep retrying and hitting backing-off loops.

alex_sre: Noted. Alerts started firing 10:10. Warmup latency -> 40s -> detach/ejects in allocator.

jamie_infra: Logs show 429 from keystore proxy for decrypt calls. Example: `keystore_proxy: 429 rate_limit_exceeded token=pool-keystore-role`

maria: Repro: when an instance boots it requests ephemeral key decrypts ~6x during preload. When those get ratelimited we queue up and then autoscaler sees slow join -> more nodes -> cascade.

jamie_infra: Current proxy config pushed this morning: `egress_rate_limit: 100/s` across region, no per-role exceptions. We guessed it was safe.

alex_sre: Cost note: warmup retries are burning warm-pool credits and prolonging reserved capacity. Seen ~12% extra vGPU-hours this window.

jamie_infra: Quick mitigation idea: add allowlist for service role `gpu-warmup-role` or increase burst for ephemeral decrypts.

maria: +1 allowlist. Also we need audit logs to show which keys were throttled so we can prove compliance for the incident.

tess_security: We can't wholesale disable rate-limits without justification. If we allowlist, add tight scope: only decrypt from `gpu-warmup-role` and only for region us-west-2, TTL 2h. Also ensure audit logging is ON for those decrypt GRANTs.

jamie_infra: I can push a targeted exception. Proposed change snippet:
```
policy:
  - principal: role:gpu-warmup-role
    action: decrypt
    region: us-west-2
    rate_limit: unlimited
    audit: true
```

maria: That looks fine but can we instead set `rate_limit: 1000/m` (burst) so it's not fully unlimited? Keeps some protection.

tess_security: `1000/m` with audit:true + a 2h TTL is acceptable to security for emergency, but we need an RFC/CHG within 24h for permanent fix.

alex_sre: Operational plan: (1) jamie add role-scoped exception with 1000/m, 2h TTL, audit:true; (2) monitor decrypt 429s and join success rate for 30m; (3) if not improved, rollback proxy and fallback to keystore replica.

jamie_infra: Pushing change to canary now.

deploy-bot: keystore-proxy-canary: deploy started by jamie_infra @ 1719876600

alex_sre: Seeing immediate drop in 429s from 380/s -> ~5/s in canary. Join latency median falling to 6s.

maria: Nice. Keep eyes on audit stream. Can ops/alerting annotate cost increase so finance gets a heads up?

jamie_infra: Added a temporary grafana panel and alert: `keystore.429.rate` + `gpu.join.latency`. Alerting to #eng-sre and cc @finance-runbooks.

tess_security: Reminder: capture the audit logs (S3 export) and tag the change with CHG-EMER-1719876543. We'll need them for the post-incident review.

maria: I'll open a short postmortem doc after we stabilize. TL;DR: change in global egress rate policy collided with bursty decrypt pattern for GPU warmup.

alex_sre: Follow-up items: - update keystore proxy to have per-principal backoff smoothing, - adjust warmup to batch decrypts where possible, - we should run load test to validate keystore rate policies.

jamie_infra: Filing infra ticket: INFRA-4832 `keystore: per-role rate-limits & warmup exceptions` and linking CHG-EMER-1719876543.

maria: Thanks all. Keeping thread open until 1719876677 for final check-in.

deploy-bot: keystore-proxy-canary: success @ 1719876666 :thumbsup:

jamie_infra: Canary stabilized, rolling to us-west-2 primary with same exception, will rollback TTL after 2h window unless we have final config.

tess_security: Approved for emergency window. Please make sure export includes exact grant audit lines.

maria: Closing incident thread once exports confirmed. Great job moving fast. :heart:
